lines: Flexible Payment Options for Your Electronics Purchases
At Plorix, we believe shopping for technology should be convenient and straightforward.
Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) services can allow eligible customers to purchase electronics and divide the total cost into scheduled payments rather than paying the entire amount upfront.
When installment payment services are available through our checkout, customers can review the applicable options before completing their purchases.
This page explains how installment payments generally work, eligibility requirements, payment schedules, refunds, and important terms.
1. What Is Buy Now, Pay Later?
Buy Now, Pay Later is a payment arrangement offered by third-party financing or installment payment providers.
Depending on the provider and approved plan, customers may be able to:
* Divide an eligible purchase into smaller payments.
* Review payment dates before accepting an agreement.
* Manage installments through the payment provider.
* Complete purchases through an integrated checkout experience.
Availability depends on the provider, purchase amount, customer eligibility, and current payment integrations.
Installment payment options are available only when an eligible provider is enabled and displayed during checkout.
Not every product or transaction will necessarily qualify.

Plorix does not guarantee approval or availability of financing.
